findings.title: [Mitigated] react-router vulnerability: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
findings.description: [MITIGATED - Client-Only SPA] This CSRF vulnerability only affects React Server Components (RSC) mode request processing on a server. Since this application is a pure client-side SPA built with Vite, it is not impacted by this CSRF risk. Original: Vulnerable dependency path: react-router. Range: 7.12.0 - 8.2.0
findings.remediation: No action required for client-only SPAs. Upgrade to react-router@8.3.0 when migrating to React Router v8.
